boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Mary's College
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations with late service in the Notre Dame–South Bend area.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at LaFortune Student Center
cards.title: Taco Bell at LaFortune
cards.subtitle: 315 LaFortune Student Center, Notre Dame
cards.notes: Use the on-campus counter when its posted late service fits your evening; confirm the day’s operating details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based Taco Bell counter with documented service until 2 AM on Tuesdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists dine-in hours until 2:00 AM on Tuesday at 315 LaFortune Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Tuesday dine-in hours of 11:00 AM–2:00 AM; verify hours for the specific date.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Dixie Highway
cards.subtitle: 231 Dixie Highway, Roseland
cards.notes: This drive-thru location is a practical option for a late pickup; use its official location page to check for changes before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Roseland Taco Bell with drive-thru hours listed through 4 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 7:00 AM–4:00 AM every day at 231 Dixie Highway in Roseland.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the drive-thru open until 4:00 AM daily; dine-in is listed until midnight.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 221 W LaSalle Ave
cards.title: Taco Bell on LaSalle
cards.subtitle: 221 W LaSalle Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru rather than late indoor seating, and check the posted schedule when a late South Bend pickup is needed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown South Bend Taco Bell with drive-thru service listed as late as 4 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 AM most days and until 4:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 221 W LaSalle Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Lincolnway West
cards.subtitle: 3208 Lincolnway West, South Bend
cards.notes: For an after-hours order, use the drive-thru and confirm availability on the official page before departing from campus.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend Taco Bell whose official page lists 4 AM drive-thru closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9:00 AM–4:00 AM daily at 3208 Lincolnway West.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily drive-thru hours until 4:00 AM; dine-in is listed until 10:00 PM.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's at 5212 North Main Street
cards.title: Raising Cane's on North Main
cards.subtitle: 5212 North Main Street, Mishawaka
cards.notes: Check the day’s closing time, then choose dine-in, curbside, or drive-thru service for a late meal outside the immediate campus area.
cards.short_summary: A Mishawaka chicken restaurant with dine-in and drive-thru listed until 1 AM daily and 2 AM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's lists both dine-in and drive-thru hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Sunday–Thursday hours to 1:00 AM and Friday–Saturday hours to 2:00 AM for dine-in and drive-thru.

cards.entity_name: Culver's of Mishawaka — N Main St
cards.title: Culver's on North Main
cards.subtitle: 5520 N Main Street, Mishawaka
cards.notes: Use the location’s daily midnight close as a firm cutoff, and select the service mode that works for your group before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Mishawaka Culver's listing daily service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists lobby, curbside, and drive-thru hours of 10:00 AM–12:00 AM daily at 5520 N Main Street.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Mishawaka — N Main St
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists lobby/dine-in, curbside, and drive-thru hours until 12:00 AM every day.

cards.title: McDonald's on Lincolnway East
cards.subtitle: 2771 Lincolnway E, Mishawaka
cards.notes: A midnight option with both lobby and drive-thru service listed; confirm the current day’s hours in the restaurant locator before you go.
cards.short_summary: A Mishawaka McDonald's with restaurant and drive-thru service listed until midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 12:00 AM daily at 2771 Lincolnway E.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both lobby and drive-thru closing at 12:00 AM daily.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza at 1811 S Ironwood Dr
cards.title: Papa Johns on South Ironwood
cards.subtitle: 1811 S Ironwood Dr, South Bend
cards.notes: Use delivery when carrying food back is easier, or place a carryout order early enough for the location’s separate counter schedule.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend pizza location with delivery listed as late as 1 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until 1:00 AM Friday and Saturday, with carryout until midnight those nights, at 1811 S Ironwood Dr.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — S Ironwood Dr
cards.access_notes: Official page lists delivery through 1:00 AM Friday–Saturday; carryout closes at 12:00 AM those nights.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Miami Street
cards.subtitle: 4615 Miami Street, South Bend
cards.notes: For a weekend late order, use the official location page to confirm whether delivery or carryout is still available before placing it.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend Pizza Hut with Friday and Saturday restaurant hours listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout hours of 10:30 AM–12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday at 4615 Miami Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists both delivery and carryout through 12:00 AM Friday and Saturday; they close earlier on other days.

cards.title: Domino's on West Ireland Road
cards.subtitle: 206 West Ireland Road, South Bend
cards.notes: This location’s official page lists a midnight close; confirm the live store status before ordering or starting the trip across town.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend Domino's location whose official store page lists closing at midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official store page for 206 West Ireland Road lists the location as open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official store page reports a 12:00 AM close; check its live status before ordering because operating times can change.
